claim.claim-text: 1. A light emitting diode module, comprising:

wherein the first pad metal layer (35a) includes a protrusion having an outer contact portion (35a1) that contacts the first conductivity type semiconductor layer (23) near the edge of the substrate (21), and wherein the first pad metal layer (35a) includes a region that has a wide width and a region that has a narrow width extending from thereof.
2. The light emitting diode module of claim 1, wherein the outer contact portion (35a1) is formed to have an elongated shape.
3. The light emitting diode module of claim 1, wherein the mesa (M) has a recess and the outer contact portion (35a1) is disposed on the recess.
4. The light emitting diode module of claim 1, wherein the upper insulation layer (37) is disposed between the first pad metal layer (35a) and the second bump pad (39b).
5. The light emitting diode module of claim 1, wherein the first pad metal layer (35a) includes an inner contact portion (35a2) in a via hole.
6. The light emitting diode module of claim 1, wherein the first pad metal layer (35a) is formed not to surround the second pad metal layer (35b).
7. The light emitting diode module of claim 1, wherein the first pad metal layer (35a) is formed to surround the second pad metal layer (35b).
8. The light emitting diode module of claim 1, wherein the lower insulation layer (33) includes a single layer of SiO<2> or Si<3>N<4>.
9. The light emitting diode module of claim 1, wherein the outer contact portion (35a1) is formed by a plurality of outer contact portions (35a1) disposed to be spaced apart from one another.

10. The light emitting diode module of claim 1, wherein a boundary region (35ab) is disposed between the first pad metal layer (35a) and the second pad metal layer (35b), and the lower insulation layer (33) is exposed to the boundary region (35ab).
11. The light emitting diode module of claim 1, wherein the boundary region (35ab) is covered with the upper insulation layer (37).
12. The light emitting diode module of claim 1, wherein the first pad metal layer (35a) and the second pad metal layer (35b) include substantially the same material.
13. The light emitting diode module of claim 12, wherein the first pad metal layer (35a) and the second pad metal layer (35b) include multilayer structures.
14. The light emitting diode module of claim 12, wherein the upper insulation layer (37) is flush with the edge of the substrate (21).

15. The light emitting diode module of claim 1, further including a diffusive cover (1010) disposed on the light emitting diode (1021), the diffusive cover (1010) including a light transmitting material.
